algorithm_long: Unified material regression with target-independent descriptors, genuine TabPFN-v2/MLP gradient training and the same predeclared per-TRAIN 1206-recipe selection design. Three complete regression tasks. Built with PriorLabs-TabPFN.
notes: Three complete native five-fold tasks: phonons MAE24.924304469958248 cm^-1; refractive index (matbench_dielectric) MAE0.2564567309263447; experimental band gap MAE0.31707419178786395 eV. Each has270 inner gradient fits and5final trained models frozen before TEST inference. Own-TRAIN composition-group3fold selection with fixed ties; no adaptive shared-grid narrowing. Exact historical six-source snapshots retained per task: larger tasks change only fit timeout and job partitioning. Band gap has composition input only; its all370 option has missing structure slots, not observed crystal geometry. Prior JDFT2D exposure/correction and foundation limitations disclosed. Additional full1265GPU replay passed for phonons only; dielectric and gap provide full replay code/context with80TRAIN witnesses in their original fresh inference processes, no additional all-row replay claimed. Original task artifacts/predictions unchanged; this metadata-only native merge does not choose by score. Public release assets include all15full checkpoints/original freezes and target-free TEST replay contexts. Two declared modulus tasks remain planned and will be reported regardless of score: shear has a retained incomplete-epoch compute failure before any TEST score, and bulk training has not started. No automatic GPU retry was performed. No13-task completion or official first-place claim.
